baseline.wheelCopiesMeaning: Four copies means fully upgraded effect in the source; not four equipped slots.
baseline.upgradeLabels: E-level, OE and AA labels retained as source text; no conversion to Gnostic rank or numeric ordering.

posseCorrection.reason: Explicit text instruction overrides the pictured Posse.

placement.text: usually W4, can do some other waves too

tiers.text: SS: Lv 70 GHelot E3 + 4 copies of wheel, Thais E2 + 4 copies of wheel, Arachne e0 - 1 copy of wheel
SSS:  Lv 80 GHelot E3 + 4 copies of wheel, Thais E2 + 4 copies of wheel, Arachne e3 - 1 copy of wheel
Dissolution: Lv80 Ghelot E3 + Celestial Beast, lv70 Helot (AA), E3 Thais lv 80 + 4 copies of wheel and +12 keyflare wheel, E3 Arachne Lv80 + 4 copies of wheel

notes.text: Extra notes: Madness omen on Thais is great for dissolution and AA Thais is a big upgrade.

rationale.text: Carry levels lift base damage; Thais supplies resources and Vulnerable; Arachne amplifies the prepared burst.

placement.text: usually W1 or W3. Short exploration stages.

tiers.text: SS: Lv 80 Mouchette E3 + 4 copies of wheel +12 BOT, Arachne e0 1 copy of wheel, Horla e1. DR Wheels are replaceable just stack DR.
SSS: Lv 80 Mouchette OE + 4 copies of wheel +12 BOT, Arachne e3 1 copy of wheel, Horla e1. DR Wheels are replaceable just stack DR.
Dissolution: Lv 90 Mouchette AA + 4 copies of wheel +12 BOT, Arachne e3 + 4 copies of wheel, Horla e1. DR Wheels are replaceable just stack DR.

rationale.text: Fast Chaos burst favors short exploration; Arachne pursuit buildup improves the later burst; DR-heavy setups can depend on resets.

placement.text: Very strong - can go into any wave. But AA Gogier is MANDATORY otherwise team doesn't work

tiers.text: SS: Lv70 AA GOgier
SSS: Lv80 AA GOgier + Event wheel, Arachne w/ 1 copy of wheel
Dissolution: Lv90 AA Gogier + L70 E3 Arachne with 4 copies of her wheel + enough DRs/ rewinds

notes.text: Extra notes: On chaos ring his posse works very well/better. Clears are significantly easier if you can find his ring in shops.

restrictions.text: AA Ogier: Oathbound is mandatory according to the source; lower upgrade is not a supported substitution.

rationale.text: AA changes the base-damage contribution that Arachne amplifies. A strength-scaling replacement is a different team concept.

placement.text: Usually W5 or the most difficuly wave. Especially good vs. caro

tiers.text: SS: Vortice E1, Murphy - some WOD generating Keyflare, Saya 1 copy of WOD
SSS: Lv70 Vortice OE, Murphy E1, Saya E3 1 copy of WOD
Dissolution: Lv 80 Vortice OE +12 "We will meet again", Lv70 Murphy E1, Saya E3 Max WOD, Soul syncronization wheel available. Generates 1000+ Keyflare with cards + turn end on average

notes.text: Extra notes: WOD and team members are flexible. A bit of keyflare distributed across members on the team helps (because of keyflare diminishing returns). I put my recommended covs but these can be flexible.
4th member is flexible. Other strong options (matchup dependent who is best)
Cariboo is particularly good if you have no rewinds since the boss clear is very safe and the hardest part is the mobs.

alternatives.text: Source discusses Caraboo as a higher-investment, matchup-dependent fourth slot; not automatically selected.
Video suggests Celeste against periodic heavy attacks; not automatically selected.

rationale.text: Keyflare sustains the loop. Salvador protects opening mobs; Celeste or Caraboo can improve matchup-specific defense.

placement.text: Fairly flexible but W4 means no symptoms so best run into W3/W4

tiers.text: SS: 24 wheel, AA Doll, OE Naut, AA Ogier. Pick some wheels to improve the team
SSS: Lv 70 24 + one copy of wheel + Celestial Beast,  AA Doll, OE Naut, AA Ogier. Pick some wheels to improve the team
Dissolution:  Lv 80 24 + one copy of wheel + Celestial Beast,  AA Doll, OE Naut, AA Ogier. Use mostly suggested wheels.

notes.text: Use 24 posse.Picked the wrong one in the builder.
Alternative to 24 is to run Lotan with this team, it depends on the matchup. May need to shuffle teams around depending on which wave.
Extra notes: This team lacks keyflare so even keyflare on character who don't use arith is worthwhile for end of turn keyflare. Using murphy wheel on ogier can help if available.

restrictions.text: Video at 14:48 describes AA Doll Rouse as the defensive dependency; no lower-upgrade substitution is validated.

alternatives.text: Alternative to 24 is to run Lotan with this team, it depends on the matchup. May need to shuffle teams around depending on which wave.

rationale.text: Doll shielding and Nautila shield overcap support a slower carry. Keyflare and maximum HP remain bottlenecks.

placement.text: Choose a wave with 1 hp bar. Use 24 (borrow for either this team or prev) for harder waves

tiers.text: SS: Lv70 Tawil E3 with one copy of wheel, Gdoll e1 + 1 copy of her wheel, AA Lotan
SSS:  Lv80 Tawil E3 with one copy of wheel, Gdoll e1 + 1 copy of her wheel, AA Lotan
Dissolution: Lv80 Tawil OE with 4 copies of wheel, Gdoll E3 (OE for long exploration) + wheel maxed, AA Lotan

notes.text: (Use "The Gated Answer" if other team is using 24 posse)

alternatives.text: 24 portrait shown as Lotan replacement; introduces overlap with the 24 team.

rationale.text: Tawil, Timeworn Ramona and Chaos resource cycling support Exalts; percentage-damage Lotan favors one-bar bosses.

placement.text: Typically best when mobbing is not required (outside of blue ring). Specific matchups are significantly better than others. Best at w3 generally

tiers.text: SS: Lv70 OE Gmurphy, Goliath AA, Miriam E2, +2 handsize wheel + titan's blade +12
SSS: Lv80 OE Gmurphy,  Goliath AA maxed lily wheel, Miriam E2 - sorel wheel, +2 handsize wheel + titan's blade +12 - 2.8k+ team hp
Dissolution: As much HP as possible - heavily matchup dependent.

notes.text: Extra Notes: The realm buffs are especially beneficial to this team. GTulu is also expected to increase the power of this team - possibly replacing Tulu.

restrictions.text: Source generally favors encounters without required mobbing, outside Blue Ring.

rationale.text: Team HP supports defense; the source favors limited mobbing and matchup-specific stall, with no fixed Dissolution breakpoint.

limitations: Source season, server and combat build are not established. Sheet retrieval date is not a game-patch date.
Eight main lineup images are transcribed. Borrow portraits, expensive extras and Vivian demonstrations are not evaluated team entries.
Wheel icons, unnamed alternatives and ambiguous abbreviations are not inferred. Refer to the source for equipment images.
No win probability, damage, survival, minimum investment, gameplay verification or globally optimal roster is established.
Character identity differs across variants. Planning allows distinct catalog IDs; game-specific cross-variant restrictions remain unresolved.
Non-overlap checks cover named characters and Posse only; shared Wheels, Creations, borrows and account rules require separate review.
